messages.author: d.oyelaran@morecheese.example
messages.text: Good to have this space set up for the membership team. Wei-Lin, let us make sure we clean up the dormant accounts before the virtual symposium planning kicks off.

messages.author: w.tsai@morecheese.example
messages.text: Already on it, Desmond. I am running a script to tag anyone who has not logged in since two thousand nineteen so we can verify if they are still active.

messages.author: n.rahimi@morecheese.example
messages.text: I can draft a quick email campaign for those flagged accounts asking if they want to renew for the virtual format.

messages.author: d.oyelaran@morecheese.example
messages.text: Symposium registration numbers just crossed the threshold we discussed. We need to look closely at whether the digital-only tier is cannibalizing our annual renewals.

messages.author: w.tsai@morecheese.example
messages.text: The numbers for the return to the in-person conference are looking very strong. Artisan creameries are rejoining faster than we projected.

messages.author: d.oyelaran@morecheese.example
messages.text: That is encouraging, but let us verify if those are net-new members or just lapsed accounts returning now that events are live again.

messages.author: n.rahimi@morecheese.example
messages.text: I am gathering testimonials from returning makers for the upcoming newsletter to highlight the value of joining in person.

messages.author: d.oyelaran@morecheese.example
messages.text: We need to address the mid-tier retention drop we saw last quarter. Wei-Lin, can you pull a breakdown by region for the regional chapters?

messages.author: w.tsai@morecheese.example
messages.text: Pulling the regional data now, though note that some zip codes were entered incorrectly during the autumn drive so the totals might skew slightly.

messages.author: d.oyelaran@morecheese.example
messages.text: Corporate partners are locking in their annual financial commitments early and total membership has never been higher, but our team is handling twice as many inquiries as usual.

messages.author: n.rahimi@morecheese.example
messages.text: I am fielding twice as many routine questions from new cheesemakers about standard benefits this month.

messages.author: d.oyelaran@morecheese.example
messages.text: We are starting to field hardship dues requests due to recent creamery closures and rising operating costs. Marguerite wants a full impact report by Friday.

messages.author: w.tsai@morecheese.example
messages.text: I have flagged all accounts requesting temporary relief and separated them from the standard non-payment drop list.

messages.author: d.oyelaran@morecheese.example
messages.text: Let us check our progress on the active queue. We currently have fifty renewal outreach items assigned, with twenty-four in progress and twenty-six still open.

messages.author: w.tsai@morecheese.example
messages.text: I am working through the open batch this week, focusing primarily on the mid-sized creameries in the western chapter.

messages.author: n.rahimi@morecheese.example
messages.text: The messaging around the raw-milk aging rule updates has brought a few old members back to ask questions about compliance support.
